lyrics: And so the car was brought to a stop

A finger makes it's point

I'll always be in orbit
I'm a satellite
I want what you've got, I want a piece of you
I wish I got to know you
I like to think of space, cold and pure
Empty all around

The stars they burn with no sound
What am I doing here
A stranger on the side of the road?
I'm a satellite, brought back down to earth
I'll always be in orbit
I'm a satellite
A satellite
